classes: the bridge reads the 11 classes that pass the shape or the perceptual gate on every held-out rig (vowel_open, vowel_mid_spread, vowel_close_spread, vowel_mid_rounded, vowel_close_rounded, bilabial, dental, alveolar_sibilant, coronal_stop, dorsal and sil); labiodental, postalveolar, coronal_nasal_lateral and rhotic failed and are not read, so weight on them moves no expression signal.

example_rigs: the poses are fitted to the sculpted viseme shapes of 18 Rocketbox rigs, measured in their own ARKit units by one bounded fit for all of them, with Left and Right tied; on each of 4 other Rocketbox rigs, which the fit did not use, each pose read here either reproduces its class's own shape to within half of its motion (shape gate) or meets its class's visible mouth features within their frozen tolerances (perceptual gate); all 22 rigs come from one library, and rigs from other libraries render the same ARKit weights differently (calibration record rig-gains.ict-rocketbox-female); on ICT-FaceKit, a rig from another library, the bilabial pose opens the lips on the mid line from 0.61 to 2.95 mm instead of keeping them closed.
perceptual_tolerance: the tolerances of the perceptual gate are the spread of one library's sculpts (the training rigs' own visemes), not measured perceptual thresholds; no viewer judged them.
coarticulation: not modelled; each class is one static pose, and the poses of a blend of classes add up; RCEF has no operator over time.
teeth_tongue: teeth and tongue are not represented; the bridge writes no tongue_out, blink, gaze, jaw_sideways or mouth_shift value.

calibration_status: the record is calibrated_software, a fit to the geometry of example rigs, not a measurement of any tracker; pack schema 1.0 has no such evidence status, so the mapping is proposed.
